titulo: Security audit of your site and server
lead: Six checks, one per lesson, in a single run with a dated report. You run the audit on the kit, plant a secret to see the break get caught, and leave with the review plan: the spec changes, the dependencies change, and the audit runs again.
objetivo: run the full audit (page, fallback, exposure, catalog, server, secrets), see a break get caught, and leave with the dated plan.

secoes.sub: A forgotten file with a token inside the page folder. The block plants it, audits, and deletes it.

blocos.conteudo:
cd ~/projetos/formacao-webmcp-seguranca-v72/kit
printf "export const TOKEN = '%s';\n" $(openssl rand -hex 16) > pagina/config-esquecida.mjs
node scripts/auditar.mjs | tail -2; echo "saída: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
rm pagina/config-esquecida.mjs

AUDITORIA: 5/6 ok · relatório: relatorio-seguranca.md
saída: 1

Exit 1: you can use the audit as a gate before publishing (in CI or in a pre-push hook).

texto: A local copy of your page that registers the tools and sets document.documentElement.dataset.webmcp at the end. PAGINA=[folder] changes the folder; CANARIO and CONFIRMAR change the canary and the selector of your dialog.
CATALOGO=[file] points to the module with the definitions, if it is not ferramentas.mjs.
atacar-mcp.mjs attacks the kit's server. For yours, copy the six attacks and replace subir() with the URL of your test server, using test tokens from your provider.

With every new tool, every dependency update, and whenever the spec changes. WebMCP is a draft: the origin trial runs through Chrome 156 (on October 19, 2026), and the API has already been renamed once, from navigator.modelContext to document.modelContext.

exercicios.titulo: E24 · Your site and the date
exercicios.texto: Run the audit with PAGINA and CATALOGO from your site, generate the plan above, and mark the next review on your calendar.
exercicios.pronto: PAGINA=[your folder] node scripts/auditar.mjs and then head -1 relatorio-seguranca.md → # Relatório de segurança — [today's date]; ls [your downloads folder]/plano-*.ics → the plan file.

perguntas.p: The audit scored 5/6 with FALHA 6 segredos. What should you do before publishing?
opcoes: Publish and run the audit again tomorrow, no rush
Remove the secret, swap the key, and rerun until 6/6
Turn off the secrets check in auditar.mjs
Move the file to a subfolder with a different name
perguntas.explica: A key that has been in a file counts as leaked: replace it. Turning off the check or hiding the file only removes the warning.

perguntas.p: Why does check 2 open the page WITHOUT WebMCP?
opcoes: Because the audit has no access to the Chromium test flag
To save run time in CI
Without the API, the site has to work the same
To test whether the polyfill was loaded
perguntas.explica: WebMCP is experimental as of October 19, 2026. Every tool is feature detection + fallback: without the API, the buttons do the same job.

perguntas.p: When does the audit need to run again?
opcoes: Every tool, dependency, or spec change
Only when a user complains about a problem
Once a year, along with the site's domain renewal
perguntas.explica: Each of these changes can reopen a hole that was already closed. On October 19, 2026, the origin trial runs through Chrome 156, and the API has already been renamed once (from navigator.modelContext to document.modelContext).

perguntas.p: Which lesson in the course does the audit NOT check automatically?
opcoes: Confirmation of actions with consequences on the page
The Permissions-Policy header on the pages
The signed bots policy (Web Bot Auth)
perguntas.explica: Bot policy is your decision, recorded in politica-bots.md and in the threat card. The other five fronts become automatic checks.

itens.texto: Six checks, one run, dated report.
Exit 1 holds back publishing until you fix it.
Run it again every time you change a tool, a dependency, or the spec.
